WITH date_anchor AS (
  SELECT MAX(DateDoc) AS max_date FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet')
),
target_dates AS (
  SELECT 
    max_date - INTERVAL 1 DAY AS yesterday,
    max_date - INTERVAL 8 DAY AS last_week_same_day
  FROM date_anchor
),
sales_by_day AS (
  SELECT 
    h.DateDoc,
    CASE 
      WHEN h.DateDoc = (SELECT yesterday FROM target_dates) THEN 'אתמול'
      WHEN h.DateDoc = (SELECT last_week_same_day FROM target_dates) THEN 'שבוע שעבר (אותו יום)'

  WHERE h.DateDoc IN (SELECT yesterday FROM target_dates, SELECT last_week_same_day FROM target_dates)
  GROUP BY h.DateDoc
)

  period AS name,
  net_sales AS value,
  transactions,
  DateDoc AS date_label
FROM sales_by_day
ORDER BY DateDoc DESC

WITH max_date AS (
        SELECT MAX(DateDoc) AS max_d FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet')
      ),
      target_period AS (
        SELECT 
          date_trunc('month', max_d - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) AS start_promo,
          date_trunc('month', max_d - INTERVAL 1 MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS end_promo,
          date_trunc('month', max_d - INTERVAL 4 MONTH) AS start_baseline,
          date_trunc('month', max_d - INTERVAL 2 MONTH) + INTERVAL 1 MONTH - INTERVAL 1 SECOND AS end_baseline
        FROM max_date
      ),
      promo_items AS (
        SELECT DISTINCT l.PrtC
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
        CROSS JOIN target_period tp
        WHERE h.DateDoc BETWEEN tp.start_promo AND tp.end_promo
          AND l.MivzaNo > 0
          AND l.Cmt > 0
      ),
      baseline_sales AS (
        SELECT 
          l.PrtC,
          SUM(l.Cmt) / 3.0 AS avg_baseline_qty_monthly,
          SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) / 3.0 AS avg_baseline_revenue_monthly
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
        CROSS JOIN target_period tp
        WHERE h.DateDoc BETWEEN tp.start_baseline AND tp.end_baseline
          AND l.PrtC IN (SELECT PrtC FROM promo_items)
          AND l.Cmt > 0
        GROUP BY l.PrtC
      ),
      promo_sales AS (
        SELECT 
          l.PrtC,
          SUM(l.Cmt) AS promo_qty,
          SUM(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) AS promo_revenue,
          SUM(CASE WHEN l.MivzaNo > 0 THEN l.Scm - l.VatAmount ELSE 0 END) AS promo_discounted_revenue
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
        CROSS JOIN target_period tp
        WHERE h.DateDoc BETWEEN tp.start_promo AND tp.end_promo
          AND l.PrtC IN (SELECT PrtC FROM promo_items)
          AND l.Cmt > 0
        GROUP BY l.PrtC
      )
      SELECT 
        trim(p.Nm) AS item_name,
        ROUND(ps.promo_qty, 1) AS promo_qty,
        ROUND(coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_qty_monthly, 0), 1) AS baseline_qty,
        ROUND(ps.promo_qty - coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_qty_monthly, 0), 1) AS qty_uplift,
        ROUND(100.0 * (ps.promo_qty - coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_qty_monthly, 0)) / NULLIF(coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_qty_monthly, 0), 0), 1) AS qty_uplift_pct,
        ROUND(ps.promo_revenue, 0) AS promo_revenue,
        ROUND(coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_revenue_monthly, 0), 0) AS baseline_revenue
      FROM promo_sales ps
      LEFT JOIN baseline_sales bs ON ps.PrtC = bs.PrtC
      JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/Prt.parquet') p ON ps.PrtC = p.C
      WHERE coalesce(bs.avg_baseline_qty_monthly, 0) > 5
      ORDER BY qty_uplift DESC
      LIMIT 15

WITH ic AS (
        SELECT StoreID, ItemID, arg_max(FinalRegularCostPrice, DateDoc) AS unit_cost
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/DailyPriceCost.parquet')
        WHERE FinalRegularCostPrice > 0
        GROUP BY 1, 2
      ),
      branch_metrics AS (
        SELECT 
          trim(s.Nm) AS branch_name,
          count(distinct h.C) AS transactions,
          sum(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) AS net_revenue,
          sum(h.Scm - h.ScmMaam) / count(distinct h.C) AS avg_basket,
          sum((l.Scm - l.VatAmount) - ic.unit_cost * l.Cmt) FILTER (WHERE ic.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) AS gross_profit,
          sum(l.Scm - l.VatAmount) FILTER (WHERE ic.unit_cost IS NOT NULL) AS costed_revenue
        FROM read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Header.parquet') h
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/Store.parquet') s ON h.StoreC = s.C
        JOIN read_parquet('signedRoom://comaxDemo/usersRO/parquet/OEM_BI_4466/KupaDoc_Lines.parquet') l ON l.KupaDocC = h.C
        LEFT JOIN ic ON ic.ItemID = l.PrtC AND ic.StoreID = h.StoreC
        WHERE h.DateDoc >= DATE '2024-01-01'
          AND s.C IN (1, 2, 3, 4, 5, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 40)
        GROUP BY 1
      )
      SELECT 
        branch_name,
        round(net_revenue, 0) AS net_revenue,
        transactions,
        round(avg_basket, 2) AS avg_basket,
        round(gross_profit, 0) AS gross_profit,
        round(100.0 * gross_profit / costed_revenue, 2) AS margin_pct
      FROM branch_metrics
      WHERE net_revenue > 100000
      ORDER BY net_revenue DESC
